quality_policy.fallback: Use every original solid component only when overview is absent or empty
quality_policy.overflow: Fail entire build; never truncate, substitute a footprint, or publish a partial package
quality_policy.overview: Use all existing nonempty overview primitives unchanged
quality_policy.scope: Read-only building render geometry; roads, environment, semantic groups and edit operations are excluded
